intent: Use the TraeWork episode's subtitle-led hybrid motion grammar as the preferred reference for talking-head edits with real evidence assets.
phases: talking head and one-line caption establish the claim
localized MG adds one concrete relationship or proof
real evidence enters as a complete aspect-ratio-preserving replacement
B-axis stage is reserved for a semantically marked showcase or demonstration range
the information group exits as one unit before the next group

patterns.treatment: Show the evidence at its original aspect ratio, then replace it with the next evidence or relationship state.

bestFor: small regions inside a large screenshot
patterns.treatment: Keep the screenshot at one scale and use synchronized top and bottom masks or external shading to narrow the visible attention window.
Reveal dependent items from top to bottom and keep the resolved order visible until the semantic unit completes.
avoid: revealing all items before the spoken cue

patterns.treatment: Let the evidence own the frame while the live speaker remains a visibly moving protected circular window; exit the whole stage at the marked semantic boundary.
avoid: MG covering the PiP exclusion zone

style.typography: Large 得意黑-style primary MG with normal-weight, single-line white captions kept separate.
style.surface: Clean talking-head footage with bounded translucent panels only where they carry evidence or structure.
style.palette: Inherit assets/design-system.default.json; use warm neutral surfaces with restrained green, violet, coral, yellow, and blue accents.
style.shadow: Broad, low-contrast shadows; no opaque subtitle bar and no global haze.

globalRules: The original evidence aspect ratio is authoritative: contain it, do not crop or stretch it.
A-axis groups replace one another; the previous group exits before the next unrelated group enters.
MG is supplemental meaning, never a duplicate of the complete subtitle sentence.
Every visual entrance is anchored to the spoken phrase that gives it meaning.
If a complete asset cannot fit clearly, shorten the hold or switch faster instead of shrinking it into illegibility.
Use the reference grammar, not its project-specific coordinates, copy, assets, or timing.
